worker_rules: Implement complete owned mapper/storage code, synthetic fixtures, regressions and per-dialect fidelity documentation. No private payload reads or copying.
No builds, tests, formatters, lint, rustdoc, Cargo.lock changes or root Cargo/app/core edits. PM validates and integrates. No sibling implementation waits.

Follow adapter-claude Cargo.toml with existing core/serde_json/time workspace dependencies. Storage owner may declare rusqlite with bundled feature and sha2 in its own manifest; PM owns lockfile/architecture admission.
Export static DESCRIPTOR alongside the actual mapper. Descriptor ID equals adapter.name() and emitted provenance. PM alone registers all runners/descriptors.

Use unisphere.session.record and common TelemetryRecord. Native usage remains measured components with explicit scope, never guessed standard totals, trace IDs or timestamps. Metadata-only has no content body; opt-in structured content only. Unsupported native data has safe typed diagnostics.

All guide checks are executed by PM, including scoped per-crate tests in each delivered clone before import and coordinated lockfile/dependency updates. Worker handoff is source+fixtures, not a passing-test claim. The no-worker-validation rule is deliberate and unchanged.
snapshot_contract: Core NativeSnapshot is complete bounded raw representation with revision digest. JsonDocument has key=document. JsonJournal records are ordered operations with key=journal:<ordinal>; ordinals are not byte offsets. SQLite records have exact native key strings.

Pure SnapshotAdapter reduces journal operations before projecting logical messages. Key-based SnapshotDiagnostic never invents file offsets. Include source key/session/revision provenance, not fake unisphere.source.offset.

PM provides scoped full-replacement revision manifest and checkpoint-after-output. Empty snapshots remain observable so consumers can replace a view and observe deletions. No persistent history, idempotent sink transaction or final-session claim.

Exact required snapshot record attributes: unisphere.source.adapter = descriptor ID, unisphere.source.path = source.path, unisphere.source.key = native DB key or structural document/journal location, unisphere.source.revision = snapshot.revision, unisphere.source.format = json_document|json_journal|sqlite_key_value, unisphere.source.kind = actual native kind, unisphere.profile.version = "1". Optional unisphere.source.session.id is a verified native selected session ID. unisphere.source.offset MUST be absent for snapshots. PM tk-0009 updates profile docs and collection proof to select the required provenance set by registered source representation; JSONL keeps actual byte offsets.

Loader MUST validate input before I/O, enforce limits during read, and return only NativeSnapshot values for which validate(limits) is Ok. PM snapshot collection service revalidates injected loader output against source and limits before mapping; pure mappers may assume validated bounded input. max_record_bytes bounds raw value bytes, while max_snapshot_bytes bounds native UTF-8 key bytes plus raw value bytes, including a single large key.

lanes.tk-0002: crates/adapter-codex + docs/codex-adapter.md: CodexAdapter implements SessionAdapter; DESCRIPTOR id codex. timestamp/type/payload records; distinguish last_token_usage from cumulative total_token_usage.
lanes.tk-0003: crates/adapter-omp + docs/oh-my-pi-adapter.md: OmpAdapter implements SessionAdapter; DESCRIPTOR id oh-my-pi. Handle 256-byte mutable title slot explicitly; not the Pi dialect. Name retitle-after-cursor and sidecar limitations.
lanes.tk-0004: crates/adapter-pi + docs/pi-adapter.md: PiAdapter implements SessionAdapter; DESCRIPTOR id pi. v3 header/tree JSONL; compaction/custom extension state is not a normal model turn.
lanes.tk-0005: crates/adapter-copilot-cli + docs/copilot-cli-adapter.md: CopilotCliAdapter implements SessionAdapter, DESCRIPTOR id copilot-cli. Also CopilotCliAdapterSnapshot implements SnapshotAdapter for legacy JSON, SNAPSHOT_DESCRIPTOR id copilot-cli-snapshot. Legacy work must not delay current JSONL implementation.
lanes.tk-0006: crates/adapter-vscode-copilot + docs/vscode-copilot-adapter.md: VsCodeCopilotAdapter implements SnapshotAdapter; DESCRIPTOR id vscode-copilot. Whole v1/v2/v3 snapshots and pure native kind0/1/2/3 mutation-log reducer. Read assets/vscode-journal-schema.json when available; never guess operations or usage.
lanes.tk-0007: crates/adapter-cursor + docs/cursor-adapter.md: CursorAdapter implements SessionAdapter for transcripts, DESCRIPTOR id cursor-transcript. CursorIdeAdapter implements SnapshotAdapter, IDE_DESCRIPTOR id cursor-ide. Read cursorDiskKV composerData:<id>, bubbleId:<composer>:<bubble> in fullConversationHeadersOnly order. Opaque CLI blobs need explicit unsupported semantic-mapping disposition absent authoritative codec, never an assumption of JSON.
lanes.tk-0008: crates/loader-snapshot + docs/snapshot-loader.md: FileSnapshotLoader implements SnapshotLoader. Bounded explicit nofollow JSON/journal source reads, stable source checks; SQLite read-only transaction with validated/quoted table identifier and fixed key/value columns. Return ordered native keys/raw text-or-BLOB values; no semantic decoding. SHA256 revision uses versioned length-prefixed keys and bytes. Enforce record and aggregate limits before unbounded allocation. Partial/malformed journal, source mutation or oversize never succeeds as partial reconstruction. Test real synthetic files/databases, mutation/replacement/truncation/bounds.

scope_boundary: All six harnesses are authorized. No main landing, remote push/PR, global settings, private content export or workspace retirement. Worker packet receipt grants owned work; no legacy acknowledgement/release dance.
registration_contract: PM tk-0009 retains one descriptor+runner registry for JSONL and snapshot variants. Each registration includes its source representation; production provenance regression creates an appropriate real synthetic JSONL/JSON/journal/SQLite fixture per registration, runs actual export, and asserts every emitted native record and snapshot manifest has that descriptor ID. No second metadata-only registry and no snapshot escape from provenance coverage.
